description_en: Imports phone numbers for agent outbound calls
name: AgentImportNumber

parameters.help_en: The unique request ID used for idempotent processing. A request ID is valid for 10 minutes. If this parameter is not specified, idempotent processing is not performed
parameters.help_zh: 请求id，具有唯一性，用来做请求幂等处理，一个请求id有效期10分钟。不传则不做幂等处理
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the agent. This parameter can be left empty, but you must specify either AgentId or AgentTag. This parameter is used to query the corresponding agent information
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，可以为空，但agentId与agentTag必须其中1个有值。用于查询对应的坐席信息
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the agent, which is the unique user identifier specified when the agent is created. This parameter can be left empty, but you must specify either AgentId or AgentTag. This parameter is used to query the corresponding agent information
parameters.help_zh: 坐席唯一标识（创建坐席时的用户唯一标识），可以为空，但agentId与agentTag必须其中1个有值。用于查询对应的坐席信息
parameters.name: agent_tag

parameters.help_en: The type of the outbound call. Valid values: 1001: agent manual outbound call
parameters.help_zh: 外呼类型 可选项：1001：坐席-人工外呼
parameters.name: call_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI script that is created and published by the customer or authorized by the platform. If CallType is set to 1001, this parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: AI话术ID 客户已制作并已发布/平台授权的AI话术ID，如callType=1001可不填
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The outbound call line selected for agent manual outbound calls. This parameter takes effect only when CallType is set to 1001. If CallType is set to 1001 and GatewayId is not specified, the system uses the default line configuration for outbound calls
parameters.help_zh: 坐席-人工外呼选择的外呼线路，只针对callType=1001生效，其他callType不生效。如callType=1001，且gatewayId不传值，默认按系统的线路配置外呼
parameters.name: gateway_id

fields.help_en: The URL of the customer details page, which is used to display the detailed information of the customer in the customer's business system. The URL can be up to 80 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 客户详情URL,用于展示客户用户在客户业务系统的详细信息，做多80个字符
fields.name: client_url

fields.help_en: The phone number of the customer
fields.name: number

fields.help_en: The MD5 hash value of the user's phone number. You must specify either this parameter or Number
fields.help_zh: 用户电话号码MD5，和number两者必传一个
fields.name: number_md5

fields.help_en: The specific information of the user. If the AI script template does not require variables or the call is a manual outbound call, this parameter can be left empty. The total length cannot exceed 500 characters, and excess characters are truncated
fields.help_zh: 用户具体信息。如AI话术模板没变量要求或为人工外呼，可为空(总长度500个字符，多余的会被剔除)
fields.name: properties

fields.help_en: The custom tag of the user. The tag can be up to 50 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 用户自定义标签,最多50个字符
fields.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The specific customer information, such as the phone number and name. You must specify this parameter based on the requirements of the task parameters. Note: If CallType is set to 1001, only the first data record is imported
parameters.help_zh: 具体用户信息，如手机号、姓名等，需根据具体任务参数要求传输。注：当callType为1001时，只会导入第1条数据
parameters.name: customers

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The detailed reasons for access denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 0 indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回 0 表示请求成功

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Id.description_en: The ID of the outbound call

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
